summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing supplemental financial information for the three months ended March 31, 2026, including income statements and balance sheets by activity (Industrial and Financial Services). The filing is a routine quarterly update of unaudited financial data, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or corporate action is announced. This is a standard earnings-related filing by a foreign private issuer. Thus, no deal terms apply.
